Schema

A schema records one analysis as an ordered sequence of decisions.

new_schema() build_schema() add_step() as_schema() as.data.frame(<schema>) print(<schema>)
Construct a schema
write_tines() read_tines()
Read and write tines schemas and multiverses to YAML files
draft_tines()
Draft a schema template
extract_schema() prompt_extract_schema()
Extract schema from descriptive text
get_step_names()
Functions to access components of a tine object

Mapping a schema to data

Tie each step to the variables it reads and the ones it creates, so the generated code runs against a real dataset.

gen_io() update_data() update_io()
Data mapping and validation for schemas

Alternatives

Record different ways of carrying out one or more steps of a schema.

alternative() node() new_alternatives()
Construct alternatives objects
write_alternatives() read_alternatives()
Read and write an alternatives object from/to a YML file
draft_alternatives()
Draft an alternatives template
gen_alternatives() prompt_alternatives()
Generate analytical alternatives via LLM

Multiverse

Expand one analysis into many, or collect several analyses together.

expand_tines()
Expand a schema with an alternative YAML into a multiverse
new_multiverse() as_multiverse()
Construct a multiverse

Generating and validating code

Turn a schema into an R script, then run it and repair what fails.

gen_code() prompt_gen_code()
Generate R code from a schema or multiverse
validate_script()
Auto-Fix an R Script via Iterative LLM Debugging
